entries.canonical_name: Dosimetric Proof of 3D Conformal Inadequacy (Rectal Tolerance)
entries.criterion_wording: Documented comparison confirming 3D conformal radiation would exceed safe dose constraints to parotid glands, rectum/bladder, spinal cord, or other adjacent critical normal tissues.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: 3D-CRT plan exceeds rectal wall tolerance (rectal V70 > 25%).
accepted_terms: 3d-crt plan exceeds rectal wall tolerance
3d-crt plan exceeds rectal wall tolerance constraints
rectal v70 > 25%
exceeds rectal wall tolerance constraints
3d conformal radiation exceeds safe dose constraints to rectum
prohibited_near_misses: rectal sparing alone without dosimetric comparison
imrt requested for simple palliative bone metastases
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Rectum is explicitly enumerated in the policy criterion text as a critical organ at risk. Demonstrating 3D-CRT plan exceeds rectal wall tolerance constraints is a direct factual instantiation of the criterion requirement.

entries.canonical_name: Documented Objective Knee Laxity or Ligamentous Deficiency
entries.criterion_wording: Physical examination documenting Grade II or III ligamentous instability on anterior drawer, Lachman, pivot shift, or varus/valgus stress test.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: 3+ anterior drawer, grade III Lachman, and pivot shift
accepted_terms: 3+ anterior drawer, grade iii lachman, and pivot shift
grade iii lachman
3+ anterior drawer
pivot shift demonstrating severe knee joint laxity
severe knee joint laxity
combined cruciate ligament insufficiency
prohibited_near_misses: subjective knee giving way without objective physical exam signs
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Criterion text explicitly specifies Grade II/III instability on anterior drawer, Lachman, or pivot shift. The attested clinical exam findings are direct textbook clinical equivalences.

entries.canonical_name: Medical Justification for Custom vs Prefabricated Device
entries.criterion_wording: Documented anatomical justification why an off-the-shelf prefabricated brace cannot fit (e.g. disproportionate thigh/calf circumference, severe angular deformity > 15 degrees, abnormal limb contour).
accepted_terms: conical thigh geometry
atypical lower extremity anthropometry (conical thigh geometry)
atypical lower extremity anthropometry
conical thigh circumference
prohibited_near_misses: patient preference for custom brace without anatomical abnormality
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Conical thigh geometry is an atypical limb contour and disproportionate circumference preventing fit and retention of cylindrical off-the-shelf braces. Direct anatomical subtype of policy criterion.

entries.canonical_name: Severe Central or Foraminal Stenosis on MRI/CT
entries.criterion_wording: Diagnostic MRI or CT confirming moderate to severe lumbar central canal, subarticular, or neural foraminal stenosis correlating with symptoms.
accepted_terms: severe lumbar spinal stenosis
severe lumbar spinal stenosis at l4-l5
thecal sac cross-sectional area < 60 mm2
critical central stenosis
entries.governing_rule_rationale: 'severe lumbar spinal stenosis' directly matches canonical severe central canal stenosis.

entries.criterion_wording: Headache with progressive severity, nocturnal awakening, papilledema on fundoscopy, or worsening with Valsalva maneuver.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: progressive right upper extremity clumsiness, mild expressive word-finding difficulty, and new asymmetric right facial numbness
accepted_terms: progressive right upper extremity clumsiness
progressive focal neurological deficit
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Focal motor weakness, clumsiness, and dysphasia in a patient without headache cannot be treated as a wording equivalent for 'Progressive Headache with Red Flags'. Substituting focal signs for headache criteria is a policy coverage judgment that must defer to human clinical review.

entries.canonical_name: Comparative Dosimetric Treatment Plan Demonstrating Sparing
entries.criterion_wording: Comparative dosimetric planning demonstrating that conventional photon IMRT cannot deliver target curative dose without exceeding normal tissue tolerance.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Comparative planning demonstrates that conventional photon VMAT delivers unacceptable toxic doses (brainstem max dose 62 Gy).
accepted_terms: comparative planning demonstrates that conventional photon vmat delivers unacceptable toxic doses
photon vmat delivers unacceptable toxic doses
conventional photon vmat delivers unacceptable toxic doses (brainstem max dose 62 gy)
constraining brainstem dose to 48 gy
prohibited_near_misses: proton therapy requested without comparative photon dosimetric plan
photon plan achieves safe normal tissue constraints
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Photon VMAT is rotational photon IMRT. Demonstrating photon VMAT delivers toxic doses to adjacent brainstem while protons constrain dose to 48 Gy is an exact factual instantiation of comparative dosimetric sparing.

entries.canonical_name: Rigid Immobilization and Organ Motion Management Plan
entries.criterion_wording: Rigid stereotactic body immobilization and documented organ motion management plan (e.g. 4D-CT respiratory gating, breath-hold, abdominal compression, fiducial tracking).
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) delivering 50 Gy in 4 fractions with respiratory motion tracking.
accepted_terms: respiratory motion tracking
sbrt delivering 50 gy in 4 fractions with respiratory motion tracking
stereotactic body radiation therapy with respiratory motion tracking
motion tracking delivery
prohibited_near_misses: free breathing delivery without motion management
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Respiratory motion tracking is a recognized modality of organ motion management in stereotactic body radiotherapy, directly satisfying the criterion requirement.

entries.criterion_wording: Qualifying diagnosis: acute MI within past 12 months, CABG, heart valve surgery, PCI/stent, stable angina, or chronic heart failure with LVEF <= 35%.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Recent surgical revascularization for ischemic heart disease in stable clinical condition.
accepted_terms: recent surgical revascularization for ischemic heart disease
surgical revascularization for ischemic heart disease
surgical revascularization for ischemic heart disease in stable clinical condition
three-vessel coronary artery bypass graft surgery
prohibited_near_misses: acute decompensated heart failure precluding exercise
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery is defined medically as surgical revascularization for ischemic heart disease. Direct clinical synonym.

entries.criterion_wording: Written physician-prescribed individualized exercise treatment plan detailing modality, frequency, duration, and target heart rates.
accepted_terms: individualized aerobic exercise plan
prescribed individualized aerobic exercise plan
cardiologist prescribed individualized aerobic exercise plan
prohibited_near_misses: general physical activity advice without prescription
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Cardiologist-prescribed individualized aerobic exercise plan verbatim satisfies individualized exercise treatment plan.

entries.canonical_name: Intermediate-to-High Pre-Test CAD Probability (Established Ischemic CAD)
entries.criterion_wording: Documented intermediate-to-high pre-test probability of coronary artery disease, or established CAD with new/worsening anginal symptoms or ischemic equivalents.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Severe coronary disease and ischemic systolic dysfunction with inconclusive SPECT.
accepted_terms: severe coronary disease and ischemic systolic dysfunction
severe coronary disease and ischemic systolic dysfunction with inconclusive spect
ischemic systolic dysfunction with inconclusive spect
established cad with ischemic systolic dysfunction
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Severe coronary disease and ischemic systolic dysfunction with inconclusive SPECT is an established high-probability ischemic CAD condition.

entries.criterion_wording: Preliminary trial of intrathecal drug administration demonstrating >= 50% reduction in pain score or severe intractable spasticity relief.
accepted_terms: 75% pain reduction
documented 75% pain reduction
preliminary trial producing documented 75% pain reduction
successful preliminary intrathecal screening trial
entries.governing_rule_rationale: 75% pain reduction on preliminary trial exceeds the >= 50% pain relief requirement. Direct clinical satisfaction.

entries.canonical_name: Intolerable Side Effects or Failure of Systemic Analgesics
entries.criterion_wording: Documented failure of or intolerable adverse effects from conventional oral/systemic analgesics (including opioids) managed by pain specialist.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Intractable pelvic pain refractory to systemic medical therapy with successful preliminary intrathecal screening trial.
accepted_terms: intractable pelvic pain refractory to systemic medical therapy
refractory to systemic medical therapy
refractory to oral opioids and neuropathic agents due to intolerable sedation
intolerable sedation from systemic opioids
prohibited_near_misses: mild pain responsive to oral nsaids
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Intractable pelvic pain refractory to systemic medical therapy and oral opioids due to intolerable sedation is an exact clinical equivalent.

entries.criterion_wording: Documented >= 75% pain relief following at least one (or two) image-guided diagnostic sacroiliac joint injections.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Severe chronic right sacroiliac joint dysfunction with positive provocative physical signs and > 75% relief on diagnostic intra-articular block.
accepted_terms: > 75% relief on diagnostic intra-articular block
85% relief of baseline pain during the anesthetic window
greater than 75% relief on diagnostic intra-articular block
relief on diagnostic intra-articular block
entries.governing_rule_rationale: > 75% relief on diagnostic intra-articular block verbatim matches the statutory criterion.

entries.criterion_wording: Severe debilitating focal vertebral pain with pain score >= 6 on 0-10 numeric rating scale (NRS) or visual analog scale (VAS).
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Pain rating is 8/10 on visual analog scale.
accepted_terms: pain rating is 8/10 on visual analog scale
8/10 on visual analog scale
pain rating 8/10 on visual analog scale
visual analog scale 8/10
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Pain rating 8/10 on visual analog scale directly satisfies VAS >= 6/10 threshold.

entries.canonical_name: Inconclusive Prior Stress Testing or Equivocal Baseline ECG
entries.criterion_wording: Documented equivocal, inconclusive, or discordant prior stress ECG / stress echocardiogram, or inability to perform physical stress testing due to baseline ECG abnormalities.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Atypical chest discomfort in intermediate pre-test risk patient with equivocal baseline electrocardiogram.
accepted_terms: equivocal baseline electrocardiogram
equivocal baseline ecg
render exercise ecg stress testing non-diagnostic
non-specific st-t wave abnormalities that render exercise ecg stress testing non-diagnostic
prohibited_near_misses: high-risk positive stress test indicating urgent catheterization
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Equivocal baseline electrocardiogram rendering exercise ECG non-diagnostic is explicitly enumerated in the criterion.

entries.canonical_name: Clinical Staging Impact on Intended Treatment Strategy
entries.criterion_wording: Documented clinical intent where PET-CT findings will directly guide management: determining surgical resectability, radiation treatment volume, or systemic therapy choice.
entries.attested_note_phrasing: Whole-body 18F-FDG positron emission tomography with computed tomography (PET-CT) for initial oncologic staging.
accepted_terms: pet-ct for initial oncologic staging
initial oncologic staging to determine resectability
initial systemic staging required to determine resectability
whole-body 18f-fdg positron emission tomography with computed tomography (pet-ct) for initial oncologic staging
prohibited_near_misses: pet scan for unproven experimental indication
entries.governing_rule_rationale: Initial oncologic staging to determine surgical resectability is explicitly given in the criterion description.
